requirement.text: Only authorized users shall have access to students' personal information.

initial_eus.title: Restricted Access to Students' Personal Information
initial_eus.description: As a student, I want access to my personal information restricted to authorized users, so that it is not disclosed to anyone without authorization.
work_items: Access to students' personal information is limited to authorized users.
Users without authorization cannot access students' personal information.

analysis.ethical_objective: Protect the privacy and confidentiality of students' personal information by restricting access to authorized users.

obligations.text: Access to students' personal information shall be restricted to authorized users.
obligations.source_span: Only authorized users shall have access to students' personal information.

obligations.text: Unauthorized users shall not be able to access students' personal information.
obligations.source_span: Only authorized users shall have access

constraints: Access is limited to users who are authorized.
ambiguities: The source does not define who qualifies as an 'authorized user' or how authorization is determined.
The source does not define the scope of 'personal information'.
The source does not specify what 'access' encompasses (e.g., viewing, modifying, exporting).
unsupported_assumptions_to_avoid: Do not assume a specific authentication or access-control mechanism (e.g., role-based access control, multi-factor authentication).
Do not assume specific roles (e.g., teachers, administrators) are the authorized users.
Do not assume logging, auditing, or monitoring requirements.
Do not assume compliance with specific privacy laws or regulations (e.g., FERPA, GDPR).
Do not assume encryption or other data protection measures beyond access restriction.
Do not assume a process for granting or revoking authorization.
possible_operational_aspects: Access to students' personal information is conditioned on the user being authorized.

work_items.explanation: The work item states that access to students' personal information is limited to authorized users, which directly expresses O1's restriction of access to authorized users.
The work item states that users without authorization cannot access students' personal information, which expresses O2's implied prohibition on unauthorized access.
